I bought my first pack of HemoHIM in May 2020. Four months later, the owner of the apartment where I was living came down with covid and spent about a month and a half in bed. I felt that I had caught the same illness, but 3 days later. I went through the entire illness while taking care of the sick person, staying functional and going to work. I attribute my endurance to HemoHIM.

In early April 2020, my predisposition to cancer suddenly awoke, and the lesion instantly grew in the head of the prostate gland and blocked the bile duct into the duodenum. My condition began to deteriorate rapidly, as all the bile accumulated in the gallbladder and liver and returned into the blood. I called an ambulance twice. They took me in, but I had to return home because they weren't able to do an ultrasound.

Only three weeks later was I able to get an ultrasound - the doctor immediately said that urgent surgery was needed. When the surgery began, the surgeons saw metastases in the liver, so they didn't touch the tumor, but removed the gallbladder, letting the bile flow freely into the intestine. Chemotherapy started a month and a half after the surgery.

I went through three cycles of this therapy. After the first cycle of three sessions, I asked my doctor whether I could use HemoHIM. The doctor spent a minute looking up the name on her smartphone, checked the composition, and gave a positive answer.

Over the next 5 months I used about 10 boxes of HemoHIM - 2-3 boxes a month. I also gradually added Noni Juice, Omega-3, a probiotic, and vitamin C. From time to time, with breaks, I used our Ginseng, Fucoidan, Spirulina, Pu-erh tea, and other Atomy products suited to my digestive system issues.

Since April 2022 I've been living in Spain under the supervision of oncologists at a hospital in Alicante. Regular contrast CT scans and blood tests show remission. It's already been 5 and a half years, and my health and well-being keep improving. I believe my main, most effective saviors, in order of importance, are - HemoHIM, Noni Juice, Red Ginseng, vitamin C, and Fucoidan.

I can't explain this in scientific terms. I'm just sharing my personal observations, which I've noticed for several years now. The same thing happens on film sets. There comes a moment when your body is already asking for rest, but the filming process continues. It's exactly in such moments that I especially appreciate having HemoHIM always by my side.

Of course, I understand that a lot has changed over these years. My lifestyle changed, my diet changed, I started moving more, film work appeared along with new work loads. So I can't claim that HemoHIM alone was the cause of these changes. But I clearly remember that it was right after getting to know this product that I first saw a positive result, which inspired me to keep taking care of my health.

HemoHIM's formula uses three plant-based ingredients that are traditionally used together, and the product contains no added sugar. That's exactly the approach that resonates with me.

Over these years, HemoHIM has become for me not just a dietary supplement. It has become part of my everyday rhythm of life. I'm grateful to Atomy for the fact that I once discovered this product.
